 Order
The captioned writ petition is filed by the petitioners assailing the order passed by the Reference Court on an application filed under Section 151 of The Code of Civil Procedure.

2. The present petitioners filed application under Section 18(1) of the Land Acquisition Act challenging the award passed by the Land Acquisition Officer in respect of land bearing Sy.No.105/1 and Sy.No.105/2 of Mannikeri village of Gokak Taluka.
Respondent Nos.1 and 2 acquired the land measuring 1-Acre 36-Guntas to implement the Rameshwar Lift Irrigation Project and were awarded compensation of Rs.1,48,116/- by SLAO.
The petitioners herein sought reference and Reference Court has enhanced the compensation by fixing the market value of the land at Rs.3,60,000/- per acres.
The operative portion of the order, however, indicated that NC: 2024:KHC-D:9798 petitioners and three others are entitled to receive enhanced compensation with statutory benefits.
3. It is in this background, an application is filed under Section 151 of CPC.
Respondent No.1 rejected the application on the ground that enhanced compensation cannot be disbursed only in favour of petitioner No.1.

Assailing the said order, the original claimant before the reference court,
i.e., petitioner No.1 and his brother Hanamappa have filed this petition questioning the said order.
4. Petitioners filed impleading application to implead other two brothers i.e., respondent Nos.3 and 4.
The said application is allowed.
In the impleading application, petitioners herein have contended that their lands are allotted to the present petitioners and respondent Nos.3 and 4 have no right and title over these lands.
5. This factual matrix is admitted by the learned counsel for respondent Nos.3 and 4.
He would point out that respondent Nos.3 and 4 have no right over the property in question and they admit that these lands were allotted to petitioner Nos.1 and 2 in the family partition.

In the light of the NC:
Govindappa Laxmappa Malali vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89992339/
2 2024:KHC-D:9798 submission made by the learned counsel for respondent Nos.3 and 4, the impugned order is liable to be set aside.
